changesMade: Layered a section-local radial veil (styles.wash) over the shared fleet-wash gradient so the lower-left two thirds of the panel reads as a hazy wash instead of strong blue, without editing globals.css
Nudged the section-local grain overlay opacity from 0.16 to 0.22 to close the measured texture-strength gap
Pulled the tablet text column up by 2rem (and mobile by 1rem) so the lead's ghosted run clears the horizon/ripple band instead of sitting on it
summary: Polished the fleet backdrop's wash reach and grain strength and lifted the lead text off the horizon at tablet/mobile, all via section-local CSS with no shared-file or layout changes.
